items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Rip Mupp Joe. >> [INTERVIEWER] This is Rip Mupp Joe huh? Where does Rip Mupp Joe come from anyhow? Who thought that up? [INTERVIEWEE] Buddy did.

ctx.x: We'd build up and build up and build up and build up and build up and build up and build Old time man. Rip Mupp Joe.
This is Rip Mupp Joe huh? Where does Rip Mupp Joe come from anyhow? Who thought that up?
